notes:
### New

- Explorer levels. You earn experience from opening things, finding things you haven't seen, crafting, killing what hunts you, finding hints, performing the rite and getting out. Firsts pay extra. "+X Experience" shows under the clock as you earn it, and the results screen shows what you made and any level you reached. You keep what you earned even if you die.
- Every 1000 experience is a level, up to 60, and each level gives a skill point.
- The skill tree. From level 1 your level shows beside your avatar at the top of the dashboard: it opens the Skills page. Open Nerve, Grit or Craft for a point, then raise its four skills up to three ranks each, a point a rank. Hold a skill to spend a point (X on a controller). Each skill's tooltip shows what it does now and at the next rank, in the game's own numbers.
- Respec. Put every point back for $1000, and spend them again. Your experience and level stay.

### Changes

- The game starts windowed again. Switch to fullscreen in Settings or with F11.
- The confirm step on the Loadout page no longer lists the free loadout.
